task: Six independent tower top-view concept references

Preserve roof construction, weapon, materials, palette, flags and decorative identity of source, merely change camera and regularize ground footprint. Building axes horizontal/vertical in image, firing direction points toward top of image. Square neutral beige background, soft studio shading, one complete building centered with ample padding including any weapon protrusion; no cropping. No people, text, grid, rulers, dimension arrows or labels. Bottom stone pedestal sides vertical, not tapered. Do not stretch roof length artificially; modest eave overhang allowed. This is concept reference not a diagram. Footprint intention 2x2 tiles: stone pedestal outline from above must be perfectly SQUARE, width equal depth. Chinese arrow tower with intact grey-tiled hip-and-gable roof, elegantly upturned eaves, red-brown wood beams; no cannon. Roof obscures interior from overhead, do not make cutaway. Strictly 90 degree vertical overhead: no front/back/side wall elevation visible. Keep clear padding all around.
